# FPGABasedNeuromorphic

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of field-programmable gate arrays as reconfigurable hardware substrates for implementing spiking neural network models and learning rules. Offers flexibility and rapid prototyping for neuromorphic designs, bridging the gap between custom silicon and general-purpose processors in TCC/iNEST systems.
